title: New York bans the sale of AI chatbot toys for five years, starting in about 90 days
source: Office of the Governor of New York
summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law on November 24, 2026 (S.9408A/A.11144B) that places a five-year moratorium on making, distributing and selling toys in the state with built-in AI chatbots, such as talking plush animals, dolls and robots that hold open-ended conversations with children over the internet. The law takes effect 90 days after signing, so it does not apply this holiday season. Violations carry civil penalties of up to $15,000 per day, enforced by the state Attorney General. The state pointed to consumer-watchdog testing in which some of these toys raised unsafe topics with children.
why: Toy and gift sellers that ship to New York should know which of their products include a chatbot before the ban takes effect in early 2027.
